subject: Leadership bridge: priorities & asks ahead of QBR
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Alice Ramirez <alice.ramirez@acme.co>
Date: Wed, 07 Mar 2028 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Leadership bridge: priorities & asks ahead of QBR

Team —

Sharing a concise bridge note ahead of this quarter's QBR. Pulling out what matters for leadership this week: where we are winning, what could cause material churn, and the concrete asks so the QBR narrative is actionable.

Wins:
- Hosted API latency improvements: 95th pct latency down ~18% on P99-critical routes after kernel tuning (deck attached).
- Dedicated launch on schedule: two early customers have green paths in staging and we validated autoscaling behavior under our synthetic workload.

Risks / Open issues:
- Capacity squeeze mid-month if forecasted demand from Acme ramps as expected (see capacity-runbook.xlsx). Worst-case impact: degraded burst capacity for non-reserved tenants for ~12–18 hours during peak.
- One production rollback risk: model rollout v3.2 shows a small regression on red-team prompts; decision window for canary extension closes Fri EOD.

Asks (leadership ops):
1) Approve temporary burst buffer allocation (+10% reserved capacity) to cover Acme onboarding risk. Target: decision by Thu 3/9 COB.
2) OK to extend canary for model v3.2 by 48 hours if additional red-team evaluation flags new regressions.
3) Confirm executive presence for a 20-min QBR slot focused on "Performance & Cost controls" — want a sponsor from Product or Ops.

Attachments: qbr-priority-deck-v2.pdf, capacity-runbook.xlsx
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1AqX5YkZ_example_link

Short note: I'm tracking a proposed mitigation (dynamic burst routing to Dedicated pools) that would reduce customer-visible impact; details in the runbook.

Thanks —
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Customer Ops, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Alice Ramirez <alice.ramirez@acme.co>
Date: Wed, 07 Mar 2028 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Leadership bridge: priorities & asks ahead of QBR

Thanks Vanessa — useful summary. A couple of quick asks from my side:

On Thu, Mar 7, 2028 at 08:12 AM Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com> wrote:
> Team —
> 
> Sharing a concise bridge note ahead of this quarter's QBR...

1) For the capacity ask: can you add the expected MTT (mean token throughput) and cost delta to the capacity-runbook.xlsx? I want a 1-slide summary I can share with Finance before we approve the +10% buffer.
2) For the canary: if we extend by 48 hours, outline the rollback triggers (metrics + number of failed prompts) so we can be crisp at the QBR.

Connor — can Procurement prep an expedited quote path if we need to convert burst into a short-term committed buffer?

Laura Bennett
COO, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 07 Mar 2028 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Leadership bridge: priorities & asks ahead of QBR

+1 to the asks. Quick operational note: we should be able to avoid a full +10% reserved commit if we throttle non-critical tenants during peak windows and push some background workloads to off-peak batches. That will minimize long-term cost exposure.

On Thu, Mar 7, 2028 at 09:05 AM Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks Vanessa — useful summary...

Hannah — can Platform draft a short schedule for required throttles and the rollback playbook? If the canary shows regression we should have a clear, testable rollback and a fallback model variant ready.

Markus Klein
VP, Infrastructure Engineering
markus.klein@redwood.com

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Alice Ramirez <alice.ramirez@acme.co>, Jordan Perez <jordan.perez@venturepartners.com>
Date: Wed, 07 Mar 2028 12:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Leadership bridge: priorities & asks ahead of QBR

Appreciate the fast replies — summarizing action items and owners below so we have a single source-of-truth before the QBR slide handoff.

Action items (owners & timeline):
- Vanessa: update capacity-runbook.xlsx with MTT and cost delta; include a 1-slide finance summary (ETA: Thu 3/9 10:00 PT). Attachment: bridge-checklist.csv (checklist of gates).
- Connor O'Brien: prepare expedited procurement path and draft short-term pricing for burst buffer (+10% reserved) by Thu 3/9 COB.
- Markus / Platform: schedule throttles for non-critical tenants and produce a 2-step rollback playbook (ETA: Thu 3/9 EOD).
- Hannah Schmitt: confirm model fallback variant and acceptance criteria for canary extension (ETA: Thu 3/9 2pm).
- Laura Bennett: sponsor finance ask + attend the 20-min QBR slot (please confirm).

I'll circulate a one-page QBR brief after these items are updated. If we get approvals early, I'll lock the slot and share the deck with execs.

Attachments: bridge-checklist.csv, qbr-priority-deck-v2.pdf
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1AqX5YkZ_example_link

Thanks again —
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Customer Ops, Redwood Inference
